To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the pharmacokinetics (PK) of the CDK4/6 inhibitor abemaciclib are adequately described by a linear one-compartment PK model with time- (Frel) and dose- (Frel, dose) dependent relative bioavailability, and that the extent of CDK4/CDK6 target engagement in skin is successfully predicted by combining the clinical PK model with the pre-clinical PK/pharmacodynamic model.

the population PK model for abemaciclib adequately describes the PK of the compound in cancer patients and that target engagement in skin can be predicted using a pre-clinical PK/PD model combined with the population PK model.
the pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics of abemaciclic were well characterized by popPK modeling.
